lines.text: Our present sufferings are not comparable to the glory that will be revealed in us.
The creation waits eagerly for the revelation of the prophets of Israel, in hope of being set free from decay.
The whole creation groans in childbirth pains, and we wait patiently for what we do not yet see.
In our weakness, the Spirit Himself intercedes for us with songs of praise.
God works all things together for good for those who love Him, and those He justified, He also glorified.
